112rtbe.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR547384
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
This request comes down from Head Office.
We’ve just learned that a recent ship attack near [LOCATION] might have been the work of a notorious and equally elusive outlaw ringleader. The last time they popped their head above water was years ago, so this is a rare opportunity to catch them. This is an opportunity that our client does not want to pass up. We need a top-tier operative with elite combat experience to retrieve the blackbox of this downed ship in order to prove the ringleader’s involvement.
There will be highly-trained hostiles present on the scene who will put up significant resistance to your presence. Eliminate them and complete the mission.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Immediately scramble to [LOCATION] and clear the surrounding airspace in order to secure the blackbox. Once obtained, deliver it to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:
Head Office stresses that this will be an incredibly difficult mission to pull off. Make sure you bring your A-game.
112rtbe.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #BR547384
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
这个请求来自总部。

我们刚刚得知，最近在 [LOCATION] 附近发生的飞船袭击可能是由一个臭名昭著且难以捉摸的非法分子团伙所为。他们上次露面已经是多年前的事了，所以这是一个难得的机会。我们的客户不想错过这个机会。我们需要一名具有精英战斗经验的顶级特工来回收这艘被击落飞船的黑匣子，以证明该团伙的参与。

现场将有训练有素的敌对势力，它们会对你的到来进行强烈抵抗。消灭它们并完成任务。

合约调查员的行动：
立即前往 [LOCATION]，清理周围的空域以确保黑匣子的安全。一旦拿到黑匣子，将其送往 [DESTINATION]。

补充说明：
总部强调，这将是一个极其艰巨的任务。一定要全力以赴。

CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = 1000
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Client's hauler was transporting some high value cargo when they decided to respond to a distress beacon and got ambushed by a group of outlaws. The client believes their pilot is gone but their cargo could still be recovered.
The information we have so far is that you'll need a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers, a heavy-duty tractor beam for shifting the goods, as well as your support ships to help deal with the outlaws at the location.
Client will be expecting the completed delivery to be made to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
This contract is non-negotiable.

99g5hi.description_en:
[TARGET] was a name that proved particularly troublesome for some time. Whether a master of evasion or just unerringly lucky all of our attempts have thus far failed.
With that being said, it seems that someone else may have beaten us to the punch so to speak. We’d like you to visit [LOCATION] and confirm if the target has indeed been neutralized. But be advised, I suspect they’re former crew may still be in the area, most likely out of a misplaced sense of loyalty. I’d suggest a crew of your own for this one, but will defer to your expertise.
Sincerely,
Vaughn

话虽如此，看来似乎有人抢先我们一步了。我们希望你去 [LOCATION] 确认一下目标是否真的被干掉了。不过得提醒你一下，我怀疑他之前的船员可能还在这附近，大概是因为错把忠诚当回事儿。我建议你自己带个队伍去，不过具体怎么安排就看你专业了。

此致，
沃恩

r8ifk4.description_en:
We've been trying to play nice with these Citizens for Prosperity people, but they've made it abundantly clear that we don't have a place in their 'safe system.' Their use of mercs for security have been causing all kinds of unreasonable violence like when this asshole [TARGET] opened fire on a group of settlers to drive them away from an outpost they'd been eyeing. So now the gloves are coming off.
I need some hard workers to go hit [LOCATION] and take out [TARGET]. Odds are, they'll stay hidden until you prove you're enough of a threat, so make sure you do some damage.
Stows out.
r8ifk4.description_zh:
我们一直试图与这些繁荣公民好好相处，但他们已经非常清楚地表示，在他们的“安全星系”里我们没有立足之地。他们雇佣佣兵提供安保，结果导致了各种不合理的暴力事件。比如那个混蛋 [TARGETNAME] 对一群定居者开火，以将他们驱离一个他们盯上的前哨站，所以现在是时候不再客气了。

我需要一些干劲十足的人去攻击 [LOCATION]，干掉 [TARGETNAME]。直到你证明你是个威胁之前他们都可能会隐藏起来，所以务必要搞出来一点破坏。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

tkyuj4.description_en:
We got a situation. Some gang that no one’s heard of are trying to make a name for themselves by targeting our transport ships. They think they can make a big show of how tough they are raiding our haulers and acting like they’re big shots. Amateurs.
Problem is, they got lucky during their last attack. Our pilot barely made it out alive, but their ship is still sitting full of supplies over at [LOCATION].
Grab a crew you can trust and your heavy-duty tractor beam and get your ass over there.
After, drop the gear off at the freight elevator in [DESTINATION]. You do this for me and I’ll give you a good cut of the sale.
-Twitch
tkyuj4.description_zh:
咱们有点情况，一帮名不见经传的小混混，想靠劫咱们的运输船出名，以为抢几艘货船就能当老大，真当自己是个人物了。一群菜鸡。

问题是，他们上次运气好，咱的飞行员差点没命逃出来，但他们的船还停在 [LOCATION]，装满着物资。

挑几个信得过的兄弟，带上你的重型牵引光束，然后赶紧给我滚过去。

搞到货之后，直接送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，这事办成了，我分你一大笔。

- 刺痛

1mg6ncr.description_en:
I got a situation I need dealing with pronto. A rival crew has intercepted a major shipment of gear I was expecting and all hell is breaking loose. The pilot’s ghosted, the ship’s busted, and it’s only a matter of time before they take my shit and leave. If you’re up for cracking these assholes, head to [LOCATION] and get my five packages.
Head’s up though, the pilot they ghosted was one of my best, so this crew’s got to be seriously kitted out. Bring your finest mates with you and show the bastards no mercy. Understood?
When you’re done, take the gear to [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you get a serious cut of the takings.
-Twitch
1mg6ncr.description_zh:
我有个紧急情况需要处理。一个竞争对手的团队截获了我正在等待的一批重要物资，现在一片混乱。飞行员失踪了，飞船也毁了，他们很快就会拿走我的东西然后离开。如果你愿意对付这些混蛋，就前往 [LOCATION] 取回我的五个包裹。

不过要提醒你，那个失踪的飞行员是我最得力的成员之一，所以这个对手团队肯定装备精良。带上你最厉害的伙伴们，别给他们任何机会。明白了吗？

完成后，把装备送到 [DESTINATION]，我会确保你得到丰厚的报酬。

-刺痛

--------------------------------------------------------
----------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT -----------------
--------------------------------------------------------
BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION
The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.
NAME: [TARGET]
SYSTEM: [SYSTEM]
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: <None>
NOTES: As your standing in the community continues to grow, the Bounty Hunters Guild would like to offer you the chance to earn a Journeyman Tracker License.
This license would signify that you are qualified to track and apprehend High-Risk Targets (HRT). These criminals can travel in larger multicrew ships with several escorts. The additional offensive and defensive capabilities make them difficult targets for all but the most skilled guild members.
To successfully complete this certification process, you must apprehend a HRT ranked criminal by the name of [TARGET] last seen at [LOCATION].
BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice
The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

60obmq.description_en:
Hi,
Normally Reyes schedules our hauls, but she’s gone for the day, and I just got a comm inquiring about a simple, direct run from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. The cargo is a load of fruit that will lose its value if it spoils. We don't want to anger this client, so would appreciate it if you knocked this out in a timely manner.
Here’s some other details you should know. The largest container used is 2 SCU, so don’t forget your handheld tractor beam.
Sincerely,
Petra Ling
Managing Director of Cargo Operations
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
60obmq.description_zh:
嗨，

平时都是雷耶斯安排货运，但她今天不在，我刚接到个消息，说有一单简单的直达运货，从 [LOCATION] 到 [DESTINATION]，货是水果，放久了就烂，价值直接归零，我们可不想惹毛这客户。如果你能及时解决这个问题那我将感激不尽。

顺带一提，最大集装箱的尺寸是 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE]，别忘了带个手持式牵引光束，不然真搬不动。


此致，
佩特拉·玲
货运运营总经理
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

Need a reliable contractor to pick up some packages for us and deliver them to their destination.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Hiya,
Looking for a hauler willing to make a run to Ruin Station. Know hauls to Pyro can give some people pause, but this is one we do regularly to help supply the station. I’ve also confirmed that everything on the cargo manifest is above board.
If you’re interested, the cargo is ready for pick up at [LOCATION]. Make sure you bring a handheld tractor beam and a ship that can hold 24 SCU cargo containers otherwise it might be a little rough.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

嗨呀，

如果你感兴趣的话，货物已经在 [LOCATION] 准备好装载了。记得带上 手持式牵引光束 和一艘能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸货物集装箱的飞船，不然可能会有点麻烦。

LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.
If you head to [LOCATION], there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

5y99dz.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP38100
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Hockrow Agency is looking for new contractors with a strong stomach and familiarity with dangerous situations to handle the legwork of an active missing persons investigation.
Reports indicate that it is highly unlikely that you will encounter any hostiles.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Travel to [LOCATION], search for [TARGET], and confirm their status. If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.
Additional Notes:
Successful completion of this task will open up other employment opportunities within Hockrow Agency.

霍克罗事务所正在寻找具有较强心理承受能力且熟悉危险情况的新承包商，以处理这起正在进行的失踪人员调查的实地工作。

12dobtv.description_en:
Just got word that some of the Nine Tails involved in the recent assault on Orison are convening near [LOCATION] before launching their next attack. We need a capable fighter pilot to head them off and take care of them before they start wreaking havoc again.
To complicate matters, from what we know there’s a very high chance that they might have additional reinforcements inbound, so be sure the extra ships don’t take you by surprise.
All the best,
Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

更棘手的是，据我们所知，他们极有可能正在调集增援部队。所以务必小心那些突然出现的飞船，别被打了个措手不及。

祝一切顺利，

凯文·沃尔顿

1j2mr6y.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
One of our haulers ran into some engine trouble whilst transporting some cargo for us and was forced to abandon their ship. Looking for a contractor who can recover the cargo and complete the delivery. You’ll need to bring your own heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the cargo to your ship. Details below.
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
Be advised, the recovery location hasn’t been verified as safe. You might find an opportunistic outlaw trying to take the cargo for themselves, so be on alert.
TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.
1j2mr6y.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

我们的一名货运司机在运输货物时发动机出了故障，被迫弃船。现寻找承包商打捞货物并完成交付。你需自带重型牵引光束，将货物转运到你的飞船上。详情如下。

找回地点
     · [LOCATION]

卸货地点
     · [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯

请注意，打捞地点的安全性尚未确认。你可能会遇到趁火打劫的不法分子企图抢走货物，务必提高警惕。

以你的工作为荣 - 即使你是外包承包商，你也代表红风货运。切勿故意做出任何损害公司声誉的行为。

1h2sd98.description_en:
Hey there,
If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one.
A beacon has just gone live at [LOCATION], from a client whose [SHIP] is in need of [FUELTYPE], so make sure your pods are topped off.
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.
Waiting to hear from you,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
1h2sd98.description_zh:
你好啊，

如果你加装了加油设备，可能会喜欢这个任务。

一个信标刚刚在 [LOCATION] 附近上线。是一位客户的委托，他的 [SHIP] 需要 [FUELTYPE]

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

看起来是个零麻烦、一次搞定就完事的活，但保持扫描器开启总没坏处。
如有兴趣请告知，我们好让这些人顺利启程。

静候佳音，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

1f5lxrl.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size.
Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
1f5lxrl.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

需要一名飞行员，将货物从 [LOCATION] 的货物电梯运输到 [DESTINATION]。
只要你的飞船能装下最大 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，这项任务应该很简单。

几乎没有比这更轻松的赚取信用点的方法了。只要小心点，因为这条路线可不是最安全的区域。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

10rvymv.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Got a request from a farmer in Pyro for specialized agricultural supplies - namely, ranta dung. Apparently, normal fertilizers aren't cutting it. They've put in orders from multiple distributors and need someone to bring everything back to [DESTINATION].
Here are all the places you can collect the dung:
PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]
The client says your ship needs to be able to carry at least 8 SCU cargo containers. Don't forget to bring your own handheld tractor beam for loading and unloading.
10rvymv.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”

以下是你可以收集有机粪便的地点（任意顺序）：

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

客户说你的飞船至少得能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱。别忘了自带手持式牵引光束，方便装卸。

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
One of the folks over at [LOCATION] just hit me up about a pile of cargo, 4 SCU or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.
DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]

10ea4ms.description_en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer
> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC) and components by stripping abandoned ships and removing the requested parts by hand with a tractor beam. We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager.
Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.
> Requirements <
- Any class/size of salvage ship
- A handheld tractor beam
> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

1yc4h88.description_en:
My boss is looking for an available hitter. Headhunters are looking to retake [LOCATION]. The CFP Mercs there have been digging in for a long fight. Look, we don't want to kill anyone we don't have to, so we're looking into other options.
Security there's being run by [TARGET] and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?
-Stows

我老大在找一个可以出手的雇佣兵，猎头帮正打算重新夺回在 [LOCATION]。那里的佣兵已经准备好进行一场漫长的战斗。听着，我们不想杀任何非杀不可的人，所以我们在寻找其他路子。

那里的安保由 [TARGETNAME] 负责，我的判断是如果他被解决掉，其他人就会四散而逃。流一点血总比流很多好，对吧？

- 斯托斯

1p8uf8t.description_en:
Any interest in taking out a [TARGET] for us?
Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by [LOCATION] soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.
They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.
You pull this off and I'll toss 3 Council Scrip to the main contractor for a job well done.
- Stows
1p8uf8t.description_zh:
有兴趣帮我们解决掉 [AMBUSHTARGET] 吗？

应该不会太麻烦。我们已经踩好点了，发现他们很快就会经过 [LOCATION]。你只需要藏在附近的辐射云里，就能打他们个措手不及。

目标可能是单枪匹马或带着几个帮手，都是单座战机但空战能力不俗。等交火开始后，我们会派些人手过去支援。

你要是能把这事儿办成了，我会给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为报酬。

- 斯托斯

ftk13.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
ftk13.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
由于我们的采购渠道发生变化，舒宾星际目前正在寻求从该地区独立矿工处购买多种材料。虽然在贸易中心出售可能获得比完成我们的订单获得更具竞争力的价格，但许多矿工发现，加强与舒宾的关系是职业生涯中明智的长期投资。

[HINT_LOCATION] 要获取这些矿物的详细产地列表，请查阅你的 mobiGlas 日志中的《采矿基础 #2：去哪里采矿》。如果你需要复习如何获取这些材料，也可以顺便阅读第一部分《采矿基础 #1：基本概述》。

由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

1dv5t7j.description_en:
Due to a corporate restructuring, Foxwell has some new vacancies that need to be filled immediately. Foxwell knows you’ve previously expressed interest in this line of work, and we’re wondering if you would want to take another crack at a contract.
One of our clients needs support at [LOCATION] where their security forces are struggling to handle an outlaw incursion. Head there and help the local forces get rid of the problem before it’s too late.
Successfully complete this contract, and Foxwell would be happy to send more work your way.
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
1dv5t7j.description_zh:
由于公司重组，福克斯韦尔有一些急需填补的新职位空缺。福克斯韦尔知道你之前曾对这类工作表示过兴趣，我们想知道你是否愿意再次尝试一份合约。

我们的一位客户在 [LOCATION]需要支援，那里的安保部队难以应对不法分子的入侵。前往那里，帮助当地部队在问题失控之前解决它。

成功完成这份合约，福克斯韦尔将很乐意为你提供更多工作机会。

尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

你知道的，老规矩。

4an2ok.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
4an2ok.description_zh:
嘿你好，

我有一个在 [LOCATION] 那的信标，这次的任务比平时复杂一些。有一支小型舰队请求补充 [FUELTYPE]。他们协调性好的出奇，计划性又差得离谱。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

ywigs3.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for rare materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
There are only a few known locations where these materials can be sourced, mainly from now defunct Hathor Group sites on Daymar and Aberdeen. Our suggestion would be to head to the Platform Alignment Facilities (PAF) and attempt to reactivate their Orbital Laser Platform (OLP) to access the materials below the planet's surface.
Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
ywigs3.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻找能够完成另一份稀有材料采购订单的合作伙伴。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

只有少数已知地点可以获取这些材料，主要来自位于戴马尔和阿伯丁的现已解散的哈索尔集团遗址。我们建议前往平台校准设施（PAF），尝试重启其轨道激光平台（OLP），以获取行星地表下的材料。

提醒一下，由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你准备好出售我们所需的材料，请将其存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

2l9tda.description_en:
A bunch of outlaws have been harassing our client and recently things have taken a turn for the worse. They've taken over their property and we've exhausted all other options.
We need a decent pilot to head to [LOCATION] and take out their fuel tanks. If you can cut off their supplies, you can pave the way for the client to take back their property.
This shouldn't be a tough one. You might run into a ship or two and maybe a few turrets, but you've been authorized to use lethal force. All we need for you to do is get in there, get the fuel tanks, and get out.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
2l9tda.description_zh:
一帮不法分子长期骚扰我们的客户，近来事态急剧恶化，他们甚至强占了客户的产业，我们已别无选择。

现需一名靠谱的飞行员前往 [LOCATION]，摧毁其燃料罐。只要切断他们的补给线，就能为客户夺回产业铺平道路。

这任务不算太难，你可能会遇上一两艘飞船和几座炮塔，但你已获授权可使用致命武力。我们唯一的要求是：进去、炸掉燃料罐、然后撤离。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保

mef97z.description_en:
Calling all pilots – one of our clients is looking for some protection for their [OBJECTS], based in [LOCATION]. From what we’ve gathered, the attackers are a group of wannabe outlaw pests who probably haven’t realized the value of the assets they’re trying to destroy, just wreaking havoc for the sake of it. Still, the client’s property is important, so should be kept as intact as possible.
If you take care of them to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 2 MG Scrip to the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
mef97z.description_zh:
呼叫所有飞行员 - 我们的一位客户正在为其位于 [LOCATION] 的 [OBJECTS] 寻求保护。据我们所知，这群袭击者自诩为不法分子，他们可能并未意识到自己试图摧毁的资产价值，纯粹是为了破坏而破坏。尽管如此，客户的财产至关重要，必须尽可能保持完好无损。

j0i4bb.description_en:
Calling all pilots – one of our clients is looking for some protection for their [OBJECTS], based in [LOCATION]. From what we’ve gathered, the attackers are a group of wannabe outlaw pests who probably haven’t realized the value of the assets they’re trying to destroy, just wreaking havoc for the sake of it. Still, the client’s property is important, so should be kept as intact as possible.
If you take care of them to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 2 MG Scrip to the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

puh6xk.description_en:
Hey,
Have a bit of good news for you. Covalex recently finished an evaluation of our contractor pool, and decided to reconsider your status as a cargo hauler. To requalify, all you need is to successfully complete the following delivery.
Pick up Quartz from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] and deliver it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. In order to complete this haul in a fast and efficient manner, you'll need a ship that can haul 1 SCU cargo containers.
Hopefully everything goes smoothly so we can welcome you back to the team.
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
puh6xk.description_zh:
嘿，

我有个好消息要告诉你，科瓦莱什最近完成了对我们备用承包商的评估，并决定重新考虑你作为货运员的身份。要重新获得资格，您只需要成功完成下列的投递。

从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯取得 [[ITEM]] ，并把它送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。为了快速高效地完成这次运输，你需要一艘能运 尺寸为 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 集装箱的飞船。

希望一切顺利，这样我们就能欢迎你重新回到队伍了。

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。


科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

1371a3s.description_en:
Hello,
Need a contractor for a simple cargo haul going from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. At most the containers will be 4 SCU in size.
Also, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Any chance you’re available to take care of it for us?
[SIGN_OFF]
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
1371a3s.description_zh:
哈喽，

需要一位承包商来一次简单的运货，从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。尺寸最大不超过 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的集装箱。

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。

你能帮我们处理一下吗？

[CONTRACTOR]

蔡斯·休伊特
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。
